title: 第6章 燃尽了
novel_title: 手握旧日权柄，弹幕硬说我是主角(灰烬暗燃)
content_zh: byd肖凡……许牧暗骂了一句罪魁祸首，回头望了一眼身后的单元楼。伴随着女孩咯咯的阴森笑声，声控灯从四楼亮起，接着三楼，二楼……不行，逃跑来不及了，受到尖啸攻击后，双腿本就无力，自已都未必能够逃掉，更别提现在还架扶着一个人。念头急闪间，许牧四下张望，最后将目光定在右侧的一棵粗壮的白杨树，树后还有一片茂密的绿化带。只能先避一避了，希望面具哥还能醒过来，现在只有他那件超凡物品能解除危机。哐！伴随一声巨响，单元楼的破铁门被撞飞出来，抛落在十几米外，紧随其后的是一个挺着“毛茸茸”大肚子，怪异的身影。在夜里，在不明显的月光下，那些蠕动的触手有着不可名状的恐怖。完全变异成怪物的女孩跳出来，没有第一时间发现目标，她站在原地，脑袋左右巡视。“小哥哥们，你们在哪儿？出来呀……咯咯咯。”“如果不能杀掉你们，肖凡哥哥一定会怪我的……”“这是我绝对不允许发生的事情！！”说着，她脑袋突然向后仰去，颈椎、脊柱、腰椎同时弯曲，双掌倒撑在地上，成了一个桥状，表皮生长着密集乳白触手的巨大肚子朝向天空。许牧趴在绿化带里，借助着粗壮白杨树和繁茂的绿植隐蔽，眼睛时不时透过枝叶间隙观望女孩那边的动作；双手则迅捷地翻找面具人的衣服口袋，试图从他那里翻到一些能用的东西，比如那件超凡物品。但他并没有抱太大希望，因为他不清楚那件物品是什么，长什么样，怎么使用。“我要来抓你们喽……咯咯咯……”女孩尖细的笑声再度传来。许牧忙里偷闲地向那边瞥了一眼，看见那些触手根根竖起，仿佛变得坚硬无比。蹭！蹭！蹭！突然间，它们开始不停地伸长、回缩，疯狂穿刺周围的任何物体。两轮下来，那片在她攻击范围内的区域已千疮百孔，烟尘弥漫。这是打算无差别攻击？还好这里距离够远……许牧暂时松了一口气。这时，他的手摸到了冰凉的物体，随后成功在面具人的工装裤口袋里翻出了一些东西。那是四枚由不同材质铸造的金属牌，上面刻绘着不同的复杂纹路，形状也各有不同。看着金属牌上面的复杂纹路，许牧竟有一种熟悉感，他左右翻转，上下颠倒地调整角度，仔细辨认起来。这……这是古代文字！许牧终于弄清楚了那种熟悉感的来源。作为历史系大学生，他的课表里就有一门课程，专门研究古代文字。从样式上看，这应该属于中古语，这个金属牌上的意思是，敏捷。他依次辨认出其他三枚金属牌上的词语，一个是‘雷电’，另外两个都是‘静谧’。这难道也是超凡物品？许牧皱眉，猜测起它们的作用。这时，他眼角余光瞥见怪物女孩开始一边移动，一边发起无差别的攻击方式，而且距离他的位置越来越近。如果再不做点什么，再过几分钟他和面具人都会被刺成蜂窝煤。许牧一咬牙，心一横，拿起那枚刻有‘敏捷’的金属牌。一边释放自已的灵性与之接触，一边出声念道：“敏捷！”尝试无果后，他很快改变思路，用中古语的发音再次念道：“敏捷！”这次，金属牌表面光华流转，有一股力量顺着他的灵性，进入手指，流遍全身。许牧顿感自已的身体轻盈起来，关节更加灵活。他之所以挑选这枚金属牌，是怕‘雷电’可能会召来一道闪电把自已劈死，而‘静谧’猜不透意义，透着诡异感，只有‘敏捷’看起来相对安全。看来我还蛮有瞎猫碰死耗子的天赋……自我吐槽了一句，许牧眼神变得严肃起来。这玩意儿肯定有时间限制，得抓紧时间。他右手撑地，身体弹起，一步跃出绿化带，向小区外面狂奔而去。许牧不得不再次感叹超凡力量的神奇，普通人类天花板的速度也不及他现在的一半。这就是风的感觉吗？这是他第一次切实体会到超凡力量带给自身的变化。跑着跑着，许牧后脑位置突生凉意，那块头皮下的神经在疯狂跳动示警，让他本能地想要弯腰躲避什么。他没有对抗这种感觉，跟随本能，迅速低头弯腰。唰！！！一根乳白色尖细触手贴着他头顶刺过，插进了前方的地面里，要是刚才他没有低头弯腰，这一击将直接贯穿他的后脑。这就是危险预感！不错嘛！！许牧左掌撑地，右脚一蹬，灵活地转了个向，躲避补刀攻击的同时从左侧绕过前方触手，继续奔跑。在他身后，怪物女孩的触手充当钩锁，将她身体荡于空中，如蜘蛛侠般穿梭高楼之间，紧追许牧不放。许牧或翻滚，或跳跃，或闪身，或连滑带铲地依靠危险预感躲过了一次又一次致命攻击。怪物女孩也锲而不舍地追了他好几条街。该死……有点难缠啊……许牧咬着牙，表情开始凝重。他原本的计划是利用速度优势，先将怪物女孩引开，自已再趁机摆脱她，迂回到幸福小区，带面具人转移至安全地点。然后就只需要安心等待面具人醒来，让他使用那件超凡物品解除这片集体潜意识空间。但现在许牧感觉自已好像无法摆脱怪物女孩的追击。更糟糕的是，他发现自已的速度、身体灵活性相较之前都减弱了不少。他推断应该是‘敏捷’金属牌的效果时间快要到了。如果自已失去了敏捷加成，即使有危险预感，本身的身体素质也未必能做出正确的反应。“你怎么这么烦！”“怎么还不死！！”或许是所有的攻击都被目标躲过，怪物女孩开始暴躁起来。她悬挂于两栋楼之间，身后残月将她巨大诡异的阴影投射于地面，完全覆盖住下方渺小的许牧。看见那阴影仰起脑袋，许牧顿感不妙。“你去死啊啊啊啊！！！”暴怒的尖啸声向四周冲击而去，声波的形状仿佛要凝成实质，扭曲了月光，震碎了周围几栋楼的玻璃。许牧只觉脑袋像被狠狠抡了一锤子，痛得要炸开，眼角、嘴角、鼻孔、耳朵纷纷有血液流出。他全身的力气在这一刻全被驱逐，身体一软直接瘫倒在地。即使这样，他依旧没有昏迷，‘精神序列’还在发力。许牧翻了个身，挣扎着坐起来，看见一条乳白触手正呼啸着横扫而来。按照惯例，我临死前你不是应该跟我长篇大论，让我恢复实力将你反杀吗？说好的反派死于话多呢，这是一点机会不给啊……看来只能使用那个了，许牧有些不舍地看了看左手。随后，他无视危险预感的强烈反对，脑袋一歪躲过攻击，同时左手往上一举迎上了触手。噗嗤！触手横扫而过，带起一片血花，许牧半只手掌连着四根手指飞了出去，只留下大拇指完整地长在剩下的半只手掌上。执念之触已挂载。就在女孩的触手和许牧的左手触碰的一瞬间，许牧就对其发动了执念之触。他推断女孩的内心执念现在就两个，一个有关肖凡，一个则是杀死自已和面具人。至于哪个更深……我赌你对你肖凡哥哥爱的深沉。虽然执念之触会让她不易死亡，但自已本来就伤不到她，所以不重要。重要的是假如她的最深执念是关于肖凡的，那么在达成那个执念之前，她就不会再做任何与执念无关的事情。手废了一只，身体极度虚弱，刚才施展‘执念之触’也抽空了剩余的灵性。反正我是燃尽了，如果赌错，大不了死给你看……许牧咬紧牙齿，眉头紧皱，强忍左手传来的钻心剧痛，本能地发出嘶嘶哈哈的声音。“演唱会，我要去参加演唱会。”“肖凡哥哥说他要在那里让我们升华，我必须去。”吊在半空中的女孩忽然自言自语，随之露出茫然的表情，她用力一荡，落在许牧面前。因为许牧坐在地上，所以她微欠身体，让身子矮下一截，颇有礼貌道：“小哥哥，这是哪里？你知道肖凡哥哥的演唱会在哪里举办吗？”幸运女神在微笑……赌对了……许牧本能地身体后仰，尽力远离着那个肚子。女孩脸色苍白，带着高中生的青春、稚涩，长相不错。其实正常起来，还是不错的姑娘，只可惜……许牧抬起左手仅剩的大拇指往身后随意地指了指：“那边，一直走。”女孩对着他鞠了个躬道：“谢谢你小哥哥，你的手伤得很严重，还是赶快去医院吧。”说完，她两根触手勾住两旁的楼房墙壁，猛地收缩，将她拽上了夜空。什么立体机动装置……默默腹诽了一句，许牧踉跄着站起，准备回去找面具人。噔噔噔！一阵急促的脚步声由远及近，许牧眺望过去，发现一个人影正疾速飞奔过来。正是头戴棒球帽的面具人。
content_en: bydXiao Fan...Xu Mu secretly cursed the culprit and looked back at the unit building behind him.Accompanied by the girl's sinister laughter, the voice-activated lights came on from the fourth floor, then the third floor, then the second floor... No, it was too late to escape. After being attacked by the scream, my legs were already weak, and I might not be able to escape, let alone support someone now.As thoughts flashed, Xu Mu looked around, and finally fixed his gaze on a thick poplar tree on the right, with a dense green belt behind the tree.We can only avoid it for a while, hoping that Brother Mask can wake up. Now only his extraordinary item can relieve the crisis.Bang!With a loud noise, the broken iron door of the unit building was knocked out and dropped more than ten meters away, followed closely by a strange figure with a "furry" belly.At night, under the dim moonlight, those wriggling tentacles are indescribably terrifying.The girl who completely mutated into a monster jumped out. She didn't find the target immediately. She stood there and looked around with her head."Little brothers, where are you? Come out...cluck." "If I can't kill you, Brother Xiao Fan will definitely blame me..." "This is something I will never allow to happen!!" As she said that, her head suddenly tilted back, her cervical spine, spine, and lumbar spine bent at the same time, and her palms fell on the ground, forming a bridge shape, and her huge belly with dense milky white tentacles growing on its surface faced the sky.Xu Mu lay down in the green belt, using the thick poplar trees and lush green plants to hide himself. From time to time, his eyes watched the girl's movements through the gaps between the branches and leaves. His hands quickly rummaged through the masked man's pockets, trying to find something useful from him, such as the extraordinary item.But he didn't have high hopes because he didn't know what the item was, what it looked like, and how to use it."I'm coming to catch you...giggle..." The girl's high-pitched laughter came again.Xu Mu glanced over there in his busy schedule and saw those tentacles standing upright, as if they had become extremely hard.rub!rub!rub!Suddenly, they began to extend and retract, frantically piercing anything around them.After two rounds, the area within her attack range was riddled with holes and filled with smoke and dust.Is this an indiscriminate attack?Fortunately, it was far enough away... Xu Mu breathed a sigh of relief for the time being.At this time, his hand touched a cold object, and then he successfully dug something into the pocket of the masked man's overalls.They were four metal plates made of different materials, with different complex patterns engraved on them and different shapes.Looking at the complex patterns on the metal plate, Xu Mu felt a sense of familiarity. He flipped it left and right, adjusted the angle upside down, and identified it carefully.This...this is ancient writing!Xu Mu finally figured out the source of that familiar feeling.As a college student in the history department, he has a course in his schedule that specializes in the study of ancient characters.Judging from the style, this should belong to the Middle Ages. The meaning of this metal plate is agility.He recognized the words on the other three metal plates in turn. One was 'Thunder and Lightning', and the other two were 'Quiet'.Is this also an extraordinary item?Xu Mu frowned, guessing their role.At this time, out of the corner of his eye, he saw the monster girl start to move and launch indiscriminate attacks, and she was getting closer and closer to his position.If something was not done, he and the masked man would be stabbed into honeycomb in a few minutes.Xu Mu gritted his teeth, his heart pounding, and he picked up the metal plate engraved with 'agility'.While releasing his spirituality to make contact with it, he said aloud: "Agile!" After trying to no avail, he quickly changed his mind and said again in the pronunciation of the Middle Ages: "Agile!" This time, the brilliance on the surface of the metal plate flowed, and a force followed his spirituality, entered his fingers, and flowed throughout his body.Xu Mudun felt that his body became lighter and his joints became more flexible.The reason why he chose this metal card was that he was afraid that 'Thunder' might summon a bolt of lightning to kill him, while 'Quietness' could not figure out its meaning and felt weird, and only 'Agility' seemed relatively safe.It seems that I have the talent to kill a blind cat but kill a mouse... After complaining to myself, Xu Mu's eyes became serious.There must be a time limit on this thing, so you have to hurry up.He put his right hand on the ground, bounced up, jumped out of the green belt, and ran wildly outside the community.Xu Mu had to sigh again at the magic of extraordinary power. The ceiling speed of ordinary humans was not even half of what he was now.Is this what the wind feels like?This was the first time that he had truly experienced the changes that extraordinary power had brought to him.As he ran, Xu Mu felt a sudden chill on the back of his head, and the nerves under his scalp were beating like crazy as a warning, making him instinctively want to bend down to avoid something.He didn't fight the feeling, just followed his instinct and quickly bowed his head.Uh-huh!!!A thin, milky-white tentacle pierced the top of his head and penetrated into the ground in front of him. If he had not bowed his head and bent over just now, the blow would have penetrated directly through the back of his head.This is a premonition of danger!Not bad!!Xu Mu put his left palm on the ground, kicked off his right foot, and turned flexibly. While avoiding the last-ditch attack, he bypassed the tentacles in front of him from the left and continued running.Behind him, the monster girl's tentacles acted as hooks and hooks, swinging her body in the air as she shuttled between tall buildings like Spider-Man, chasing Xu Mu.Xu Mu either rolled, jumped, dodged, or slid and shoveled, relying on his premonition of danger to avoid fatal attacks again and again.The monster girl also chased him for several streets without giving up.Damn...it's a bit difficult to deal with...Xu Mu gritted his teeth and his expression became serious.His original plan was to take advantage of his speed to lure the monster girl away first, then take the opportunity to get rid of her, detour back to Xingfu Community, and move the masked man to a safe place.Then all you have to do is wait for the masked man to wake up and let him use that extraordinary item to release this collective subconscious space.But now Xu Mu feels like he can't escape the pursuit of the monster girl.To make matters worse, he found that his speed and body flexibility were much weaker than before.He concluded that the effect of the 'Agility' metal card was about to expire.If you lose your agility bonus, even if you have a premonition of danger, your physical fitness may not be able to respond correctly."Why are you so annoying!" "Why aren't you dead yet?!" Perhaps all the attacks were dodged by the target, and the monster girl started to get angry.She hung between the two buildings, and the waning moon behind her cast her huge and strange shadow on the ground, completely covering the tiny Xu Mu below.Seeing the shadow raising its head, Xu Mu suddenly felt bad."Go to hell!!!" The furious screams rushed around, and the shape of the sound waves seemed to condense into substance, distorting the moonlight and shattering the glass of several surrounding buildings.Xu Mu felt as if his head had been hit hard by a hammer. The pain was so painful that it was about to explode. Blood flowed out of the corners of his eyes, mouth, nostrils, and ears.All the strength in his body was expelled at this moment, and his body went limp and collapsed to the ground.Even so, he was still not unconscious, and the 'mental sequence' was still working.Xu Mu turned over, struggled to sit up, and saw a milky white tentacle whistling and sweeping towards him.According to the usual practice, shouldn't you have a long talk with me before I die, so that I can regain my strength and kill you?The promised villain died because he talked too much. This was not given a chance... It seemed that he could only use that one. Xu Mu looked at his left hand with some reluctance.Then, he ignored the strong objection of the danger premonition, tilted his head to avoid the attack, and at the same time raised his left hand to meet the tentacle.Poof!The tentacles swept across, bringing up a bloody flower, and half of Xu Mu's palm flew out with four fingers, leaving only the thumb intact on the remaining half of the palm.Touch of Obsession has been mounted.The moment the girl's tentacles touched Xu Mu's left hand, Xu Mu launched the Touch of Obsession on her.He deduced that the girl's inner obsessions now only have two, one is related to Xiao Fan, and the other is to kill himself and the masked man.As for which one is deeper... I bet you love your brother Xiao Fan deeply.Although the touch of obsession will make her less likely to die, he can't hurt her in the first place, so it doesn't matter.The important thing is that if her deepest obsession is about Xiao Fan, then before she achieves that obsession, she will not do anything unrelated to the obsession.One of his hands was crippled and his body was extremely weak. The use of 'Touch of Obsession' just now also drained away the remaining spiritual energy.Anyway, I'm burned out. If I make a mistake in my bet, I'll die for you... Xu Mu gritted his teeth, frowned, and endured the severe pain in his left hand, instinctively making a hissing sound."Concert, I'm going to the concert." "Brother Xiao Fan said he was going to sublime us there, I have to go." The girl hanging in the air suddenly said to herself, then showed a blank expression. She swung hard and landed in front of Xu Mu.Because Xu Mu was sitting on the ground, she bowed slightly, making her body shorter, and said politely: "Brother, where are you? Do you know where Brother Xiao Fan's concert is held?" Lady Luck was smiling... The bet was right... Xu Mu instinctively leaned back and tried his best to stay away from that belly.The girl's face is pale, with the youthfulness and childishness of a high school student, and she looks good.In fact, normally, she is still a pretty good girl, but it's a pity... Xu Mu raised the remaining thumb of his left hand and pointed casually behind him: "Over there, keep walking." The girl bowed to him and said, "Thank you, little brother, your hand is seriously injured. You'd better go to the hospital quickly." After saying that, her two tentacles hooked the walls of the buildings on both sides, shrank suddenly, and pulled her up into the night sky.What kind of three-dimensional mobile device... After silently cursing, Xu Mu staggered to his feet and prepared to go back to find the masked man.Thump thump thump!There was a sound of hurried footsteps coming from far away. Xu Mu looked over and found a figure running over quickly.It's the masked man wearing a baseball cap.
